question: ‘Tamu Lochar’ is one of the traditional festivals of the ____________ of Sikkim. It is celebrated to mark the beginning of their new year, which falls on the 15th day of Pusa, according to the Hindu calendar Vikram Samvat and 30th December in the English calendar.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gurung community**__
